summary: Jackson (R) posted on X marking the 3rd anniversary of Oct 7, calling it 'an act of evil' and praying for Georgia's Jewish community; frames conflict solely around Oct 7 victims and antisemitism.
quote: Three years ago today, an act of evil shook Israel and the entire civilized world. We remember the victims of October 7th and their families, and we pray for the safety of the Jewish community in Georgia and around the world. Antisemitism has absolutely no place in Georgia.
